query: Find 10 buildings within 100 metres of soil- and flood-landslide hazard areas in Oslo municipality, sorted by shortest distance first.

1.description: Get kommunenummer and bounding box for Oslo municipality

2.description: Select buildings in Oslo with geometry (representasjonspunkt) transformed to EPSG:4326

3.description: Select soil- and flood-landslide hazard polygons filtered by Oslo bbox with geometry in EPSG:4326

4.description: Compute nearest distance from each building to hazards

executions.sql:
SELECT kommunenummer,
       ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(omrade)) AS minx,
       ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(omrade)) AS miny,
       ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(omrade)) AS maxx,
       ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(omrade)) AS maxy
FROM kommuner_627ee106072240e99d2b21ec4717bf01.kommune
WHERE lower(kommunenavn) = 'oslo';

SELECT bygningsnummer, kommunenummer, kommunenavn,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(representasjonspunkt, 4326)) AS geom_geojson,
       ST_Transform(representasjonspunkt, 4326) AS geom_4326
FROM matrikkelenbygning_fe504ac373564e10b85865ef2a507c63.bygning
WHERE kommunenummer = '0301' AND representasjonspunkt IS NOT NULL;

SELECT objid, skredtype,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(geometri, 4326)) AS geom_geojson,
       ST_Transform(geometri, 4326) AS geom_4326
FROM aktsomhetskartforjordogflomskred_83e4643e9cbd4a3a98fd29cb231c74.aktsomhetsomrjordogflomskred
WHERE ST_Intersects(geometri, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope(248657.27999772702, 6637442.109999995, 273925.9199989579, 6674528.679999999, 25833), 25833));
